steals.value: Make the asset a reusable source of truth: one approved model should generate hero image, angle renders, orbit video, lifestyle scene, variants, AR, and UI rather than separate Photoshop files.
Separate geometry generation from texture/material regeneration; this makes finish changes cheap and protects approved forms.
Use an explicit confidence/QA rubric: measured CAD, photo-inferred geometry, and decorative AI guesses must be labeled differently.
Use PBR maps and named lighting presets so the same asset can be relit for luxury, clinical, industrial, or seasonal campaigns.
Put a rules layer before the CTA: configuration must resolve to valid parts, price, margin, lead time, and quote output.
Ship browser-first: lazy-load the GLB, keep HTML accessible, and use a 360 orbit plus two hotspots before attempting a full configurator.
Productize review: generated, processed, approved, published, and measured are separate states with an audit trail.
Use CC0 Poly Haven HDRIs/textures/models to make fast renders look expensive without licensing friction.
Sell the business outcome this week: a photo/URL becomes a bookable page, a quote, a room-fit proof, or a conversion asset—not merely a mesh.

do_not_copy.value: Do not present an AI mesh as CAD-accurate. Rebuild critical dimensions, interfaces, clearances, and moving parts parametrically in FreeCAD or verify them manually.
Do not promise hidden-side truth from one photo; request additional views or label occluded geometry as inferred.
Do not copy proprietary SaaS UI, datasets, model weights, generated showcase assets, or source code without checking exact license and commercial terms.

Commons Clause is a hard warning: if a source is covered by it or similar source-available restrictions, do not copy it into a commercial product; reimplement the mechanic independently or use a properly licensed API.

Do not use a $99/month Blender workflow as the product. Blender is the production tool; the sellable product is the repeatable intake, QA, asset library, orbit render, web CTA, and revenue measurement.
Do not build a slow cinematic demo before proving the one-photo -> approved asset -> booking/quote loop.
Do not ship unoptimized 4K textures, unbounded scene graphs, or a heavy 3D hero that hides the phone CTA; create web and render-quality versions.
Do not imply that 'free', MIT, CC0, a hosted free tier, and a commercial model license mean the same thing; verify each dependency, model, binary, and generated-asset term.
